name: run_order_state
description: Operational vocabulary for traust_ops.run_order.state; Core enforces new writes, while stored historical text remains readable.

definitions.planned: A routing or scheduling request exists but admission has not queued it.
definitions.awaiting_approval: Admission is waiting for a verified approval before queueing.
definitions.queued: The order is admitted and available for claim.
definitions.leased: A worker holds the order lease.
definitions.degraded: The work completed with explicitly counted coverage gaps.
definitions.refused: The worker declined work that could not be performed under its policy.
definitions.withheld: Admission dropped the planned request, for example because of its budget.

standard.none: Project-defined operations vocabulary; existing value spellings are preserved.

note: Live DDL consumer: traust_ops.run_order.state. This is not a JSON Schema enum site. Diagnostic detail belongs in structured logs, not in classifier values.
